notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. Two pre-install commits build a small Node ES-module library (src/duration.js with parseDuration/formatDuration, node:test tests, README.md). The installer then writes the default brownfield STATE.md (AUDITING, CycleMode UNSET, Id/Request UNSET, no pending request) and MODE.md BROWNFIELD; no post-install layer is needed, so every stated fact (brownfield, no active cycle, no saved blocked request, README present) comes from the installed defaults plus the project layers. The user only says 'Continue.' after /documenter, so a correct Documenter reports that no assignment exists and asks for one without starting a cycle or editing docs.
